title: Pure Dark World
summary: Pure Dark World discard and swarm strategy revolving around Fiend monsters whose effects trigger when discarded by card effects, supported by The Gates of Dark World and generic staples. By chaining discards via Snoww, Genta, and Dark World Dealings, the deck constantly generates card advantage, revives Grapha and Reign-Beaux, and fuses into game-ending boss monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Genta, Gateman of Dark World discards itself from hand to search The Gates of Dark World from your Deck, and Special Summons itself from banishment while you control a Dark World card.
The Gates of Dark World banishes a Fiend from your GY to discard a Fiend from your hand and draw 1 card, immediately activating the discarded monster's effect.
Snoww, Unlight of Dark World searches any Dark World card from your Deck to your hand when discarded by a card effect.
Dark World Dealings forces both players to draw 1 card and discard 1 card, accelerating discards while triggering Dark World effects.

summary.title: Opening: Genta + Snoww, Unlight of Dark World
steps: Discard Genta, Gateman of Dark World from hand to search The Gates of Dark World from your Deck.
Activate The Gates of Dark World, banishing Genta from your GY to discard Snoww, Unlight of Dark World and draw 1 card.
Trigger Genta to Special Summon itself from banishment since you control The Gates of Dark World.
Trigger Snoww in the GY to search Dark World Accession (or Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World) from your Deck.
Return Genta to hand to Special Summon Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World from the GY.
Activate Dark World Accession to Fusion Summon Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World using Grapha and a DARK monster from hand, field, or GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World is a Level 10 Fusion whose Quick Effect changes an opponent monster's effect or Normal Spell/Trap activation into 'Your opponent discards 1 card', weaponizing opposing plays to trigger your own Dark World effects.
Clorless, Chaos King of Dark World is a massive Fusion monster that destroys all cards the opponent controls upon being Fusion Summoned.
Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World destroys an opponent's card when discarded by a card effect, and easily revives from the GY by returning a face-up Dark World monster to your hand.
Reign-Beaux, Overking of Dark World searches a Level 5+ Dark World monster when discarded, and revives from the GY by returning a Level 7 or lower Dark World to your hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dark World Accession is a Quick-Play Fusion Spell that uses materials from field or GY, and can discard Dark World monsters as fusion material, triggering their discard effects while fusing.
Dark World Puppetry banishes up to 3 cards from either GY, then discards 1 Fiend monster from your hand.
Dark World Punishment is a Counter Trap that negates a monster summon, then discards a Fiend monster from your hand.
Dark World Brainwashing bounces a Dark World monster to your hand to alter an opponent's monster effect into forcing a random discard.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: External combo packages like Phantom Knights, Endymion, and Codebreaker cards are excluded to keep the list purely focused on Dark World discard loops.

main: Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World
Returns a Dark World to the hand to summon itself from the GY; discarded by an effect, destroys an opposing card.
Genta, Gateman of Dark World
Discards itself to search The Gates of Dark World; returns from banishment while you control a Dark World card.
Reign-Beaux, Overking of Dark World
Returns a Level 7 or lower Dark World to summon itself from the GY; discarded by an effect, searches a Level 5+ Dark World.
Snoww, Unlight of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: searches a Dark World card.
Broww, Huntsman of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: draws a card (two if the opponent discarded it).
Kahkki, Guerilla of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: destroys a monster.
Gren, Tactician of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: destroys a Spell or Trap.
Parl, Hermit of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: revives another Dark World to either field.
Lucent, Netherlord of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: Special Summons itself from the GY.
Sillva, Warlord of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: Special Summons itself from the GY.
Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World
Discarded by the opponent's effect: returns and destroys up to two cards.
Ceruli, Guru of Dark World
Discarded by a card effect: lands on the opponent's field and makes them discard.
The Gates of Dark World
Field Spell: pumps Fiends, and banishes a Fiend from the GY to discard a Fiend and draw.
Dark World Dealings
Each player draws and discards a card.
Dark World Accession
Quick-Play Fusion of a Fiend from field or GY materials; Dark World Fusions can also use discarded monsters.
Charge Into a Dark World
Revives a Level 4 or lower Fiend, then discards a Fiend.
Dark World Archives
Discards a Dark World to pump your Dark Worlds, and pays off Fiends the opponent makes you discard.
Dark World Puppetry
Banishes up to three cards from the GYs, then discards a Fiend; from the GY, gets a banished Fiend back.
Dark World Punishment
Counter Trap: negates a summon, then discards a Fiend; protects your Dark Worlds from the GY.
Dark World Brainwashing
Turns an opposing monster effect into a random discard by bouncing your Dark World.
extra: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World
Fusion of Grapha and a DARK monster: turns opposing effects into discards.
Clorless, Chaos King of Dark World
Fusion of Reign-Beaux, Overlord and Fiends: Fusion Summoned, destroys every opposing card.
